attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has informed the Exchange about Earning Conference Call
voiceSummary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has scheduled a post-results conference call for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2027. The event is set for Thursday, 19th November 2026, at 4:00 PM. The call will feature Mr. Nitin Khara, Chairman and Managing Director, and Ms. Prity Bhabhra, Company Secretary. Participants can join via the universal dial-in numbers plus 91 22 6280 1557 or plus 91 22 7115 8383. For further details, investors may contact CA Sakshi Shah at Go India Advisors via the email address SakshiS@goindiaadvisors.com or through the provided registration link. The company has submitted this notice to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and The Bombay Stock Exchange pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 455,628 lacs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 12,638 lacs. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at Rs. 464,376 lacs, yielding a profit after tax of Rs. 13,172 lacs. The company reported total assets of Rs. 338,269 lacs on a standalone basis and Rs. 403,541 lacs on a consolidated basis as of September 30, 2026.
